title: docs(sprints): register MAINT-DEFER-008/009/010 — CI signal-quality and numerics debt
intent: Registers a CI signal-quality defect found while re-running a flaky check on PR #297: containers.yml waits for the API container to become ready and then curls the client container single-shot, so client readiness is assumed rather than asserted. Ledger + evidence only; containers.yml is not edited. Extended to also register MAINT-DEFER-009 and MAINT-DEFER-010, both surfaced by the PR #305 review and neither caused by it.
behavior_change: None. Adds one evidence document and one SPRINTS.md record. No workflow, script, dependency, or runtime file is touched — in particular .github/workflows/containers.yml is deliberately NOT modified.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds MAINT-DEFER-008 as an index row after the MAINT-DEFER-007 row and a detail section between MAINT-DEFER-007 and CI-RED-001, following the existing *-DEFER-* record shape, plus a supporting evidence document under docs/ci/. The record states the asymmetry precisely: containers.yml:56-58 polls ${SERVER_PORT}/health for up to 60s (30 x 2s) while ${CLIENT_PORT} appears nowhere in that loop, and containers.yml:100-106 then curls the client single-shot with no --retry or --retry-connrefused. Also updates the SPRINTS.md `Last updated` header from 2026-08-18 to 2026-08-19.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No record covers containers.yml smoke readiness. CI-RED-020 is CLOSED and covered the API-side blind reachable-check; its remedy produced scripts/ci/wait_for_api_ready.py, which containers.yml never adopted — MAINT-DEFER-008 records that unadopted tail on the client side rather than reopening the closed sprint. CI-RED-005 concerns the container build swallowing an sg-spec install failure, a build-time defect, not a smoke-time readiness race. MAINT-DEFER-005/006/007 (merged via #297) cover dependabot grouping, 3D test coverage, and bundle size respectively.

commands_run: Asymmetry read directly from .github/workflows/containers.yml on main 47a5d485: the readiness loop at lines 56-58 references only ${SERVER_PORT}; a grep for CLIENT_PORT in the job returns first use at line 103, inside the smoke step itself.
Failure witnessed on PR #297 run 32183393779 job 95861446559: 'Testing client container...' followed by 'curl: (56) Recv failure: Connection reset by peer' and exit code 1.

Flake-not-regression established before re-running: the failing PR changed only SPRINTS.md and a CBSP21 manifest (cannot affect a container image); `gh run list --branch main --workflow containers.yml` shows success on the preceding six commits; the same workflow shows 4/4 success on branch cursor/supabase-js-2112-42de; and the job passed on re-run with no code change.

CI-RED-020 precedent confirmed present: scripts/ci/wait_for_api_ready.py exists and is invoked by api_health_check.yml, api_tests.yml and api_health_and_smoke.yml; no reference to it exists in containers.yml.

CBSP21 selection checked before push with the gate's own function: this manifest declares 2 tokens and covers 2 changed files, versus the landed maint-defer-005-007 manifest which covers 1 — so selection resolves on coverage (ranked first) rather than tying on specificity.

MAINT-DEFER-009 evidence: `git show --stat ee36ddf1` deleted services/api/app/retopo/{__init__,miq_adapter,qrm_adapter,run,util}.py (612 lines) on 2026-02-10, commit body calling them 'unused retopology tools'; `git ls-tree -r origin/main` confirms the package is absent; examples/retopo/run.sh:16 still imports app.retopo.run and .github/workflows/mesh-pipeline-ci.yml:52-56 still runs it. mesh-pipeline-ci is failure on every main run back through 2026-01-21 — i.e. already red BEFORE the deletion, so the deletion is not the origin of the red but does make these two steps structurally unfixable.

MAINT-DEFER-010 evidence: rayleigh_ritz.py:650-657 read directly — `np.linalg.eig(np.linalg.inv(M) @ K)` under a comment declaring a generalized eigenproblem, an except branch commented 'Fallback to scipy if available' that imports no scipy and instead computes np.diag(K)/np.diag(M) with np.eye() mode shapes, and no signal in the result that the fallback ran; :660-661 then discards any imaginary part via np.real without flagging. All present before PR #305, which touched only gauss_legendre in this file.

files.intent: Register MAINT-DEFER-008 in the DEFERRED MAINTENANCE parking lot with a restore trigger.
Record the workflow evidence, the observed failure, and why it is CI-RED-020's defect shape on the client side.

Evidence for MAINT-DEFER-009 (mesh-pipeline-ci demo steps import app.retopo, deleted in ee36ddf1) and MAINT-DEFER-010 (solve_rayleigh_ritz explicit inv(M) and a fallback whose comment claims scipy while it computes diagonal ratios with identity mode shapes).

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Documentation-only. Scope limit stated plainly: no fix is applied and .github/workflows/containers.yml is untouched, so the race remains live until the restore trigger is authorized. The failure RATE is explicitly not established - one occurrence is recorded and no history sweep was run - so this record must not be read as evidence about frequency. CI-RED-020 is CLOSED and is not reopened or re-adjudicated here.
